note: Upgrade v4, Canon-safe subset (12_Systems/living_world.md). In-game days only: no real-time deadlines, no settlement changes, no ownership changes, no faction wars. Events may only do the four things in the effect kinds: stock a shop for a few days, spread a rumour, place a small encounter, pin a board note. Tuning decided 2026-11-07 by Claude under delegated creative control; the user may overrule.

pool.name: Grain caravan
pool.text: A grain caravan rolls between Brindlewick and Aldmere. The drivers sell what they cannot fit in town.

effects.text: The drivers add spare seeds and herbs to the shelves at Reed's Remedies for a few days.
Word on the road: the grain wagons are running early this week.

pool.name: Herb peddlers
pool.text: A small cart of herb peddlers stops for a day or two and shares news from the Greymoor road.

effects.text: The peddlers say the Greymoor road is quiet and the reeds are thick.
A peddler asks the board for a small errand: a bundle of Healing Herb for the cart.

pool.name: Ore wagons
pool.text: Iron Hold ore wagons pass through under guard and trade a little.

effects.text: The wagon masters boast about a new seam under the Oath-Anvil.

pool.name: Lost peddler
pool.text: A peddler has lost the road and a few kobolds are poking at the cart. Nobody is hurt.

effects.text: A few kobolds pick through a spilled cart.

pool.name: Boar crossing
pool.text: A wild boar wanders across the fields near the road.

effects.text: A wild boar in the barley.

pool.name: Jackalope pack
pool.text: A pack of jackalopes bounds through the glades.
